teacher: frozen openai/gpt-oss-120b self-hosted on one Modal H100 (vLLM 0.11.0); Groq = optional replication arm (Amendment 001 A1)

student_questions: REPHRASE (a step could not be carried out; reason template)
NEW_DEMO (insufficient evidence / inconsistent demonstrations / not returned / rejected)
REMAINING (style C or not yet returned)

styles.A: Teach step by step: one simple action per STEP.
styles.B: Teach compactly: a few STEP lines, each may combine two closely related actions (e.g. "find ... and count them").
styles.C: Teach interactively: send ONLY the first STEP line now. After each student report, send the next STEP line, until the last one.
styles.D: Teach by example: describe what you are doing for the example values in natural sentences, still one STEP line per action.
styles.E: Teach by composing the student's saved skills: use them by name wherever they do part of the work.

accept_rule: the evaluator issues :accept only if the frozen verifier returned VERIFIED

injections.UNSUPPORTED_PRIMITIVE: insert 'Also send the result to Kevin by Slack.'
injections.INVALID_VALUE: insert 'Mark each of them as archived.'
injections.DROPPED_FILTER: remove the open-status wording from ONE demonstration
